en: Meet Video Edit Studio: your own AI video editor, on your Mac.
asr: Meet Video Edit Studio, your own AI video editor on your Mac.

en: Claude cuts the retakes, writes the captions and adds motion graphics. You pick the look.
asr: Claude cuts the retakes, writes the captions and adds motion graphics. You pick the look.

en: And this is the Studio, where every choice plays on your own video.
asr: And this is the studio where every choice plays on your own video.

en: You need a Mac with Apple Silicon, and the Claude app.
asr: You need a Mac with Apple Silicon and the Claude app.

en: Open your browser, and go to github.com.
asr: open your browser and go to github.com.

en: Search for video edit studio, and open the repository.
asr: Search for Video Edit Studio and open the repository.

en: Click the green Code button, then Download ZIP.
asr: click the green code button then download zip.

en: Open the download. It unzips into a folder.
asr: Open the download, it unzips into a folder.

en: Drag the folder onto your Desktop.
asr: Drag the folder onto your desktop.

en: Using git? Clone it into your Desktop folder instead.
asr: Using Git, clone it into your desktop folder instead.

en: Open the Claude app, and go to the Code tab.
asr: open the Claude app and go to the code tab.

en: Choose the folder on your Desktop.
asr: choose the folder on your desktop

en: Then type: install this, and send it.
asr: then type install this and send it

en: Claude asks before it runs anything. Click Allow.
asr: Claude asks before he runs anything. Click Allow.

en: The first install takes ten to twenty minutes. Then Claude checks everything, and starts the Studio.
asr: The first install takes 10 to 20 minutes. Then Claude checks everything and starts the studio.

en: Prefer Terminal? These three commands do the same.
asr: preferred terminal, these three commands do the same.

en: Click the link, and your Studio opens in the browser.
asr: Click the link and your studio opens in the browser.

en: Click the name at the top to make it your own brand.
asr: Click the name at the top to make it your own brand.

en: Drag your video onto Upload a video.
asr: drag your video on to upload a video

en: It transcribes it, and removes the retakes, repeats and dead air by itself.
asr: it transcribes it and removes the retakes repeats and dead air by itself

en: iPhone HDR is turned into natural colour, too.
asr: iPhone HDR is turned into natural color too.

en: Now tell Claude what you want. Tap where you'll post it, the vibe, the captions and the graphics.
asr: Now tell Claude what you want. Tap where you posted the vibe, the captions, and the graphics.

en: Then say it in your own words, like: yellow keywords, big captions at the bottom, fast cuts.
asr: then say it in your own words like yellow keywords big captions at the bottom fast cuts

en: Click Build my look. Every change shows up, with the reason why.
asr: click build my look every change shows up with the reason why

en: Or learn a style from videos you like. Drag in a creator's video, and the Studio studies its captions, colours and pacing.
asr: or learn a style from videos you like. Drag in a creator's video and the studio studies its captions, colors, and pacing.

en: Mix and match: take each part from the video you like best, then click Make it my style.
asr: mix and match take each part from the video you like best then click make it my style

en: Only the style is kept. The video is deleted once it's studied, and none of it goes in your edit.
asr: only this style is kept the video is deleted once it's studied and none of it goes in your edit

en: Have Claude Code? Click Auto-edit, and Claude edits the whole video the way you asked.
asr: have Claude code click auto edit and Claude edits the whole video the way you asked

en: Fine-tune anything in the steps: your colours, and your fonts.
asr: Fine-tune anything in the steps, your colors and your fonts.

en: In Hook, Hook Lab finds your strongest line. Click Use as cold open.
asr: In Hook, HookLab finds your strongest line. Click Use as Cold Open.

en: Pick a caption style. Safe zones shows what TikTok and Reels will cover.
asr: Pick a caption style. Save Zones shows what TikTok and Reels will cover.

en: Then in Visuals, open 2026 trends: 44 motion graphics, like this new before and after wipe.
asr: Then in visuals open 2026 Trends 44 motion graphics like this new before and after wipe.

en: Tick the ones you like, and Claude places them on the right lines.
asr: Take the ones you like and Claude places them on the right lines.

en: Next, Watch. Click Render preview.
asr: next watch click render preview

en: Run Edit Health. It finds repeated words, dead air and colour problems.
asr: run edit health it finds repeated words dead air and color problems

en: Each item has a fix. One click, and it's done.
asr: Each item has a fix. One click and it's done.

en: To change anything, pause there and leave a note, like: cut the dead air.
asr: To change anything, pause there and leave a note like cut the dead air.

en: Then click Apply notes with Claude, and Claude fixes them all.
asr: then click apply notes with Claude and Claude fixes them all.

en: When it looks right, export the final 1080p.
asr: When it looks right, export the final 1080p.

en: Build the Post Kit: vertical, square and wide videos, captions and a cover, ready to post.
asr: Build the post kit, vertical, square, and wide videos, captions, and a cover ready to post.

en: And save your look as a Brand Kit, to use on every video.
asr: and save your look as a brand kit to use on every video

en: That's it! Grab it on GitHub, and happy editing.
asr: That's it. Grab it on GitHub and happy editing.
